package.name: myrobot_custom_slam
package.description: Lightweight 2-D SLAM for the myrobot platform (Orange Pi Zero 3). Iterated error-state Kalman filter (FAST-LIO2 formulation) fusing a single-plane lidar with an MPU9250 IMU: IMU propagation, direct point-to-line scan-to-map registration, bounded incremental voxel map.
